test_title: PYST 53: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All horses are cats.

No horse is a lion.

Conclusions:

(I): Some lions are cats.

(II): All cats are lions.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2aa08672927e5b9ba6592f955a2a499701918347f5bd130b0ea75645da1bf3cb.png] 

Conclusions:**
(I): Some lions are cats. - False (As their is no direct relation between Lions and Cats may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II): All cats are lions. - - False (As their is no direct relation between Lions and Cats may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"**
